name: token-monitor-hub-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker deployment of the Token Monitor hub.

TOKEN_MONITOR_SECRET.description: Required. Shared secret for protected hub routes. Agents, widgets, and API clients must present it when posting or reading private stats. Generate a long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

PUBLIC_STATS_ENABLED.description: Optional. Set to 1 to expose the unauthenticated GET /api/public/stats endpoint. Leave blank to keep it off.

TOKEN_M_ENROLLMENT_SECRET.description: Required for managed notifications. Private capability used only to create a new tenant.

TOKEN_M_CREDENTIAL_PEPPER.description: Required for managed notifications. HMAC pepper used to verify scoped device and mobile credentials.

TOKEN_M_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Required for Web Push. URL-safe P-256 private key; configure as a Worker secret.

TOKEN_M_VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Required for Web Push. mailto: or https: operator contact.

TOKEN_M_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Required for Web Push. Public URL-safe uncompressed P-256 key returned to paired clients.

author: Javis
